propositions: Pure single-pass prepack verifier produces false-positive rejections when prepack is imperfect; a PASS/ABSTAIN-only filter cannot reject, forcing residual criteria through narrowed agentic fallback eliminates false-positive rejection by construction.

Filter coverage is bimodal: ACs naming greppable artifacts (tests, symbols, files) PASS from static evidence packs (~90% coverage); ACs asserting runtime outcomes or store-side artifacts rationally ABSTAIN (~0% coverage).
Filter+fallback achieves -26% total input tokens and -46% on all-met real tickets vs pure-agentic control, with filter's own cost ~0.4%, while maintaining zero false PASSes on adversarial unmet ACs.
Criteria reduction via AC-block rewrite at ticket-load (monkeypatch rebar._reads.show_ticket) auto-narrows step budget and works cleanly including epic child traversal.

Prepack deterministic evidence assembly (grep-at-ref symbols/paths, file_impact slices, git-log commits, test function listings; 6KB/AC cap, never synthesized) is the quality lever; bimodal coverage suggests skipping filter for runtime-outcome-heavy AC styles.
